Rashi on Sotah 43b:10:1.hebrew: ולוקמה בכרם של שני שותפין - למה לי לאהדורי אשינויא דחיקא בנוטע לסייג ולקורות? לוקמה בנוטע לאכילה! ודקשיא לך "תיפוק לי משום דבעי למהדר משום ראשונה", לישני כגון שהנטיעה של ראובן ובא שמעון והרכיב בה, להיות פירות הרכבה שלו: ומאי שנא מחמשה אחין. ברייתא היא לקמן בפרקין (סוטה דף מד.):
Rashi on Sotah 43b:10:1.english: And let it be established [as referring] to a vineyard of two partners - Why do I need to resort to a forced answer, [namely] one who plants for a fence or for beams? Let it be established [as referring] to one who plants for eating! And [as for] that which was difficult for you: "[It should] be derived because he needs to return on account of the first [sapling]," let [the Gemara] answer [that it is] a case where the sapling belongs to Reuven, and Shimon came and grafted onto it, [with] the fruit of the grafting belonging to him. And what is different about five brothers? It is a baraita later in our chapter (Sotah 44a).

Rashi on Sotah 43b:11:1.english: They all return - Because she is awaiting levirate marriage for all of them.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:11:2.english: We apply to him [the term] "his wife" - Perhaps she will enter into levirate marriage with this one.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:11:3.hebrew: כל חד וחד לא קרינא ביה כרמו - המיוחד לו, שאין לך בה גפן שאין לשנים חלק בה:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:11:3.english: Each and every one, we do not apply to him "his vineyard" - [i.e., a vineyard] exclusive to him, for there is not a vine in it in which the two [partners] do not have a share.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:12:1.hebrew: רב נחמן אמר - הא דקתני מתני' "מרכיב חוזר", במרכיב אילן בירק, דלא בעי למיהדר משום קמא. ואם תאמר: מין בשאינו מינו הוא, ואימעיטא לה הרכבת איסור מ"ולא חיללו — פרט למבריך ומרכיב"? האי תנא הוא דאמר מותר:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:12:1.english: Rav Nachman said - That which the Mishnah teaches, "[one who] grafts returns," [refers] to one who grafts a tree onto a vegetable, where he did not need to return on account of the first [plant]. And if you say: It is [grafting] a species with a non-species, and a forbidden grafting is excluded from [the verse], "and has not redeemed it — excluding one who layers or grafts"? [It] is [in accordance with] this Tanna who says [that it is] permitted.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:12:2.english: Kefar Akko - Such is its name.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:13:1.hebrew: הא מני - דקתני פרט למבריך ומרכיב, לאו סתמא היא, אלא סיפא דמילתא דרבי אליעזר בן יעקב היא, ואפי' הרכבת היתר לא הדר עלה:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:13:1.english: Whose [opinion] is this - Which teaches, "excluding one who layers or grafts" — it is not an anonymous [teaching]; rather, it is the concluding clause of the statement of Rabbi Eliezer ben Ya'akov, and even [for] a permitted grafting he does not return on account of it.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:14:1.english: Less than a handbreadth - [Meaning] that it is low in stature and will never grow up to a handbreadth.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:14:2.hebrew: כל שנותיה - מדרבנן כל הימים ערלה נוהגת בה, דמתחזיא כבת שתא, והרואה שאוכלין פירותיה אומר שפירות ערלה מותרין:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:14:2.english: All its years - By rabbinic decree, orlah applies to it always, because it appears like [a vine] of one year, and one who sees that [people] are eating its fruits will say that fruits of orlah are permitted.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:14:3.hebrew: קלא אית ליה - הכל אומרים: כרם יש לפלוני משונה מכל הכרמים, ויודעין שהיא זקינה. להכי נקט שתים כו', דסבר לה כמאן דאמר במסכת ברכות (דף לה.) כרם רבעי תנן, שאין ערלה נוהגת בנטיעה אחת אלא בכרם שלם:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:14:3.english: It has publicity - Everyone says, "So-and-so has a vineyard that is different from all [other] vineyards," and they know that it is old. For this reason he specified "two, etc." [two opposite two and one emerging as a tail], because he holds in accordance with the one who says in tractate Berakhot (35a): We learned [in the Mishnah] kerem revai [a fourth-year vineyard], for orlah does not apply to a single sapling, but only to a whole vineyard.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:15:1.hebrew: לקריאת שמע - שאסור לקרות בארבע אמותיו משום לועג לרש, שזה קורא וזה אינו יכול לקרות:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:15:1.english: For the recitation of Shema - [Meaning] that it is prohibited to recite [it] within its four cubits because of "Whoever mocks the poor," for this one recites and that one is unable to recite.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:16:2.english: Who grew up among the brothers - The husband's sons from another wife.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:16:3.hebrew: דמתחזיא כי אחתייהו - מי שאינו מכיר בה ורואה אותה שגדלה אצלו, כסבור שהיא אחותו, ואומר שנושא אחותו:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:16:3.english: Because she appears as their sister - One who does not know her and sees that she grew up with him thinks that she is his sister, and says that he is marrying his sister.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:17:1.hebrew: לקט שכחה ופאה שעשאן - העני גורן, שכינס הרבה כאחד ועשה מהן כרי:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:17:1.english: Gleanings, forgotten [sheaves], and pe'ah that [one] made - [That] the poor person [made into] a threshing floor, in that he gathered a large quantity together and made a pile out of them.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:17:2.hebrew: הוקבעו למעשר - מדרבנן, דמאן דחזי סבור שגדל בשדהו:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:17:2.english: [They] were rendered [obligated] for tithes - By rabbinic decree, for whoever sees [it] thinks that it grew in his [own] field.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:17:3.hebrew: וה"מ בשדה - שלא ידעו הכל שנכנסו מעט מעט, וסבורין שגדל שם. אבל בעיר, כל שכיניו ראו שכינס על יד על יד, ויודעין שהן של לקט שכחה ופאה, ופטור מן המעשר, כדתניא בספרי: "ובא הלוי כי אין לו חלק ונחלה עמך" — בדבר שאין לו בו חלק ונחלה עמך, הוא בא ונוטל מעשר ראשון שלו; יצא לקט שכחה ופאה, שיש לו חלק ונחלה עמך, שאף לעניים לוים הם מופקרים כשאר עניי ישראל:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:17:3.english: And this applies [only] in the field - Because not everyone knew that they were brought in little by little, and they think that it grew there. But in the city, all his neighbors saw that he gathered [them] bit by bit, and they know that they are from gleanings, forgotten sheaves, and pe'ah, and [thus] it is exempt from tithes, as it is taught in the Sifrei: "And the Levite shall come, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you" (Deuteronomy 14:29) — regarding something in which he has no portion nor inheritance with you, he comes and takes his first tithe; excluded are gleanings, forgotten sheaves, and pe'ah, in which he does have a portion and inheritance with you, for they are ownerless even to poor Levites just like the rest of the poor of Israel.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:18:1.hebrew: אינה מקדשת את הזרעים - משום כלאי הכרם, דכתיב בהו: "תקדש המלאה הזרע". ונראה לי דקסבר כדאמרינן במנחות (דף טו:): קנבוס ולוף אסרה תורה, שאר זרעים מדרבנן נינהו, ובכי האי כרם לא גזור רבנן אשאר זרעים:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:18:1.english: It does not sanctify [i.e., render forbidden] the seeds - On account of diverse kinds of a vineyard, regarding which it is written: "the fullness of the seed shall be sanctified [forbidden]" [Deuteronomy 22:9]. And it appears to me that [he] holds in accordance with what we say in Menachot (15b): [Only] hemp and arum did the Torah forbid; other seeds are [forbidden] by rabbinic decree, and in [the case of] such a vineyard, the Sages did not decree [a prohibition] upon other seeds.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:18:2.hebrew: אבל כוליה כרם - גדול שהיא שפלת קומה, הואיל וחשיבה, גזור עליה:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:18:2.english: But [if it is] an entire vineyard - [A] large [vineyard] that is low in height; since it is significant, [the Sages] decreed upon it.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:1:1.english: Because of sins that he has - And this one must return because of "the fearful and fainthearted."

Rashi on Sotah 43b:3:1.hebrew: תלמוד לומר אשר נטע - מדלא כתיב אשר כרם נטע, דרוש ביה נמי נטע מכל מקום, ואפי' אינו כרם, שהרי לא הזכיר כרם עדיין:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:3:1.english: The verse states: "that has planted" - Since it is not written "that a vineyard he planted," one also expounds from it "planted" in any case, and even if it is not a vineyard, for it has not mentioned a vineyard yet.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:4:1.hebrew: תלמוד לומר כרם - דדמי לכרם, ופחות שבכרמים חמשה גפנים הם:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:4:1.english: The verse states: “Vineyard” - [That is, something] that resembles a vineyard, and the smallest of vineyards is five vines.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:5:1.english: “Vineyard” [is to be understood] as it indicates - And not other trees.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:5:2.hebrew: חיללו - משמע מיעוטא, לזה ולא לאחר:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:5:2.english: Used the fruit thereof - [This] implies an exclusion: for this, and not for another.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:5:3.english: One who layers - [One] who bends the vine branch or the shoot into the ground.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:5:4.hebrew: מרכיב - שנוקב האילן, ונוטל מן הרך שבענפי האילן ותוחב לתוכו, ועושה ענף בתוך הנקב, ונושא ממין אותו אילן שנוטל ממנו. וישראל מותר להרכיב משני אילנות, שזה פירותיו גסין וזה פירותיו דקין, דהוו ממין אחד זה בזה:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:5:4.english: One who grafts - That he pierces the tree, takes from the tender [part] of the branches of [another] tree and inserts [it] into it, and it produces a branch inside the hole and bears [fruit] of the species of that tree from which he took [it]. And a Jew is permitted to graft from two trees [where] this one's fruits are large and that one's fruits are small, for they are of one species [with] each other.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:5:5.hebrew: כאן בהרכבת איסור - ברייתא בהרכבת איסור, מין בשאינו מינו, ומעטיה קרא כדמעיט ולא חנכו גבי בית, פרט לגזלן:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:5:5.english: Here, with forbidden grafting - The baraita [is dealing] with forbidden grafting — [grafting] one kind onto [what is] not its kind — and the verse excluded him, just as "and has not dedicated it" regarding a house excludes a robber.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:6:1.hebrew: האי הרכבת היתר - דאוקמת מתני' בה, היכי דמי דחוזר מפני חילול ההרכבה:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:6:1.english: This permitted grafting - in which you established the Mishnah [to be speaking], what are the circumstances [such] that one returns [from battle] because of redeeming [the fruit of] the grafting?

Rashi on Sotah 43b:6:2.hebrew: אי נימא ילדה בילדה - שאף זו שבקרקע שהרכיב את הענף בה נטיעה היא, ועדיין לא הגיעה לשנה רביעית לחללה — הא לאו משום הרכבה הדר, דבלאו הרכבה נמי בעי למיהדר מן המלחמה משום ילדה ראשונה:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:6:2.english: If we say a young [tree] with a young [tree] - That even this [tree] in the ground, into which he grafted the branch, is a young sapling, and it has not yet reached [its] fourth year to redeem it — behold, he does not return because of the grafting, for even without the grafting he must return from the war because of the first young [tree].

Rashi on Sotah 43b:6:3.english: With an old [tree] - That has already been redeemed [of its fourth-year sanctity].

Rashi on Sotah 43b:6:4.hebrew: שסיבכה - לשון נאחז בסבך (בראשית כ״ב:י״ג), שעשאה ענף בזקינה:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:6:4.english: That he entangled it - [This is] an expression [similar to] "caught in the thicket [basavakh]" (Genesis 22:13), [meaning] that he made it a branch on the old [tree].

Rashi on Sotah 43b:6:5.hebrew: בטלה לגבי זקינה - ואינה חייבת בערלה, ואין בה דין רבעי. וכי תנן במסכת ערלה דמרכיב חייב בערלה, [זקינה] בילדה תנן, שאף אותו ענף חייב בערלה, ואע"ג שקצצו מזקינה, נעשה עכשיו ילדה, שזו היא נטיעתו:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:6:5.english: It is nullified with respect to the old [tree] - And it is not obligated in orlah, and the law of reva'i does not apply to it. And when we learned in Tractate Orlah that one who grafts is obligated in orlah, we learned [it regarding] an old [branch] onto a young [tree], for even that branch is obligated in orlah; and even though he cut it from an old [tree], it now becomes a young [tree], for this is its planting.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:7:1.hebrew: לעולם ילדה בילדה - ודקשיא לך, בלא הרכבה נמי בעי למיהדר ממערכי המלחמה אקמייתא:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:7:1.english: Actually, a young [tree] with a young [tree] - And as for what was difficult for you, [that] even without grafting he would also have to return from the battle lines on account of the first [tree].

Rashi on Sotah 43b:7:2.hebrew: כגון דנטעה לקמייתא לסייג - כגון שהיתה פרצה בגדר שדהו ונטעה בפרצה לסתום. לשון סוגה בשושנים (שיר השירים ז׳:ג׳) — גדורה בשושנים:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:7:2.english: A case where he planted the first [one] for a fence - For example, where there was a breach in the wall of his field, and he planted it in the breach to close [it] up. [Seyag is] an expression [related to] "hedged [sugah] with roses" (Song of Songs 7:3) — [meaning] fenced in with roses.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:7:3.english: And for beams - To cut beams from it when it grows.

Rashi on Sotah 43b:8:1.hebrew: ומאי שנא ילדה בילדה - כי הך ילדה קמייתא, דכזקינה היא לענין ערלה, (דלא בטלה הרכבה בה להפטר מן הערלה כמותה:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:8:1.english: And what is different [about] a young [tree paired] with a young [tree] - [In a case] like this first young [tree], which is like an old [tree] with respect to orla, [why] is the graft not negated in it so as to be exempt from orla like it?

Rashi on Sotah 43b:9:1.hebrew: התם - גבי זקנה, לאו בת אימלוכי היא לחזור ולהיות ילדה על שום מחשבה. אבל נטע לסייג, אי ממליך עלה בתוך שני ערלה לקיימה לפירות, חייבת בערלה. הילכך, ילדה דקא מרכיב בגוה לאכילה, חייבת בערלה; ואע"ג דלא אימליך אקמייתא, הא מיהא לאכילה הוא, ומהניא מחשבה, דעיקר דידה נמי, אי הוה חשיב עלה הוה מהני מחשבה, ואע"ג דבשעת נטיעה לאו להכי נטעה:
Rashi on Sotah 43b:9:1.english: There - In the case of an old [tree], it is not capable of being reconsidered to revert and become a young [tree] through any intention. However, [if] one planted [a young tree] for a fence, if he changes his mind about it during the years of orlah to maintain it for fruit, it is obligated in orlah. Therefore, a young [shoot] that he grafts onto it for eating is obligated in orlah; and even though he did not change his mind about the first [tree], this [grafted shoot], however, is for eating, and intention is effective [for it], since even for its trunk itself, if he had thought [to use] it [for fruit], intention would have been effective, even though at the time of planting he did not plant it for that [purpose].

Rashi on Sotah 43b:9:2.english: Just as it is concerning [trees that] grew by themselves - For at the time of planting there is no intention [for fruit].
